stats.notes: Stopping here to stay within the small USD budget. One bug confirmed and minimized: a dash that collects a coin updates state (coins=1, score=100) but the HUD still shows Coins 0/5. Minimal repro is 2 tokens: right, dash-right. Removing either token removes the coin pickup, so it is minimal. Step collection (down,down) updates the HUD correctly, so the desync is specific to dash pickup. Not explored: pause/resume edge cases, dash recharge at 0, spikes, enemy contact/swap, lever/gate, key/door, heart cap, timer expiry, dialog buttons and overlap checks.
